text:
Leah Ramos: Heads-up — we're seeing partial onboarding ingest failures for some EU tenants after last night's auth token rotation. ~120 tenants affected, manifests as 403/401 from the onboarding webhook. I'm standing up a short ops thread to coordinate customer comms.
Devon K.: Thanks Leah. Do we have a suspected root cause yet?
Rajat Sharma: Prelim root cause: auth service rotated keys but onboarding-worker and webhook-proxy didn't reload the new certs due to missing config reload on deploy. Some workers fell back to cached tokens; EU cluster cache TTL caused higher failure surface.
Ivy Chen: Observed metrics: onboarding webhook 4xx spike from 02:12–02:48 UTC, queue backlog peaked at ~45m. High-touch impacted: ACME Corp (acct: ACME-001), NovaHealth (acct: NH-REDACT). Self-serve tenants ~100 with intermittent retries.
Maya Lin: I'll draft status comms. Proposal: immediate status email to affected tenants acknowledging issue + ETA for mitigation, invite to office hours for high-touch customers at 14:00 UTC. Also prepare a short RCA summary.
Leah Ramos: Agree. Proposed goodwill: 10% onboarding credit + 1:1 enablement session for high-touch accounts. Can finance ok that?
Devon K.: Finance flagged — credits up to $5k per affected account OK, need final list.
Rajat Sharma: Mitigation applied: rolled restarting onboarding-worker pool with `--reload-config` flag in eu-cluster, pushed a hotfix to webhook-proxy to force key refresh. After restart, 80% of failed requests retried successfully. No data loss expected; messages are queued and retried on ingest. Example log snippet:
```
2026-03-23T02:20:11Z onboarding-worker ERROR 403 {"error":"invalid_token"}
2026-03-23T02:22:44Z onboarding-worker INFO retry_success tenant=ACME-001
```
Devon K.: Confirming no data loss from retries — QA spot checks on NovaHealth and ACME show successful replays.
incident-bot: Alert cleared — onboarding-worker-error-rate back to baseline (cleared at 1774502000).
Ivy Chen: I'll prepare two templates: 1) high-touch tailored note with offer and office hours invite, 2) bulk status note for self-serve tenants. Drafts will be in the cs-comm GDoc: https://docs.internal/redwood/cs/onboard-auth-incident-draft (link). :thumbsup:
Maya Lin: Office hours invite created for 14:00 UTC (Zoom + bridge). @Rajat Sharma please be on the bridge for technical Qs, @Leah Ramos to handle exec updates.
Leah Ramos: Action items: Ivy — send high-touch emails in 30m; Maya — send all-customer status email after approval; Rajat — compile timeline + logs for RCA; Devon — gather impacted-account list for finance credits; I'll own follow-ups and exec comms.
Devon K.: Noted, I'll pull account list and coordinate with finance.
Ivy Chen: Draft done, will include link to incident form for feedback and a short opt-in for 1:1 enablement. Also enabling an alert rule: `token_rotation_mismatch` to fire on future cert-rolls.
Leah Ramos: Thanks team. We'll publish a formal RCA in #postmortems after office hours and include remediation steps and timeline. Closing this thread for now; will update with RCA link. :white_check_mark:
